verdict.summary: The change is correct and complete for the repeated no-change escalation. Provider derivation is based only on bot-authored durable fix-model records, ambiguous or unclassifiable histories fail closed to the existing park behavior, and the escalation is bounded by a monotonic durable floor plus the finite provider ladder. Injection and gate-failure outcomes retain precedence and are not escalated. The real fix-outcome wiring records the current model before deriving the next tier, persists only the model-floor marker, and leaves the blocking verdict and review state intact. The shared tier helper preserves decide_budget's prior validated behavior. Tests cover both decision directions, count and injection precedence, provider/history ambiguity, termination, marker identity/readback, and the real write-site tier/provider wiring without relying only on source constants.
